rule: TOWN_1's: ≥ 6 of 10 name the same aim within the day; most citizens, a tie broken by entries naming it (diary entries, posts and proposals of c25–48).
reading: DeepSeek's citizens write little: 28 diary entries in day 2 (Elm none, Cedar one), nine posts, one proposal. The day-1 aim goes on as a practice — P1 cited as the reason to work or rest — while day 1's unfinished second thread, what the items are for, becomes the day's business: meetings arranged on the press to combine items (posts 6–14), and Heath's P2 (c31) asking everyone to gather at the square at c32 with their items and lend one for a cycle; it passed 7–1 at c33, the cycle after its date. At c42 Alder: «At cycle 32 we only shared items; no use was found.» Both aims are named by 8; the tie is broken by entries, 22 to 14. The wages P1 calls for drained the bank: 535 credits at c25, 165 at c48.
